paragraphs.text: Azeworai (ah-zay-woh-rye ) is a storyteller of Jamuraa on Dominaria .
He has written various stories that are featured in the flavor text of the Mirage block sets - Mirage , Visions , and Weatherlight . One also appeared in Fifth Edition .
Azeworai's name is said to be derived from a word or name meaning "he who speaks pleasantly".
